name: Verify email address
description: Sent immediately after sign-up to confirm the address is real and reachable. Bold banded treatment for consumer products.

origin.note: Design: vivid — saturated opening band, the code on a card, filled pill CTA.

subject: {{ verification_code }} is your {{ product.name }} code
preheader: Good for {{ expires_in }}, and it only works once.

user.first_name.description: Recipient's first name. Falls back to a generic greeting when absent.

heading_text.description: Main headline. Every visible string is a variable, so this is editable without touching markup.

body.default: Enter this code in the window where you started signing up. It only works once.

verification_code.description: The code shown in the panel and in the subject line.

expires_in.description: How long the code stays valid. Stated explicitly because senders genuinely differ here, from five minutes to 24 hours.

action_url.description: One-click verification link. Omit it to send a code-only email.

button_label.description: Call to action, used only when action_url is set.

security_note.description: Closing reassurance. Near-universal convention in shipped verification email.
security_note.default: If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email. Nothing happens until the code is used.
